cause: sed substitution replaced each matched status line by its value before the subsequent status-key quit address ran. The key was already gone, so no quit occurred; nested WARN statuses were concatenated with top-level success.
fix: Isolated system Python stdlib json.load selects exactly the top-level string status and rejects duplicate keys, nonfinite constants, missing/nonstring status, and tab/newline status values.
scope: CPU reporting-parser proof only. Does not replace raw Slurm state, alter numerical artifacts, qualify dynamics, or account/reclassify allocation cost. Scientific reconciliation and cost receipt belong to the root operator.
